title.zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
title.en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations

current_state.zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 已在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2；提案将冻结新 v1 .eth 注册，把解析迁移至 v2，将宽限期从 90 天缩短为 28 天，并把 v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需操作，提案仍处于草案阶段。
current_state.en: ENS founder Nick Johnson has submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet; it would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, migrate resolution to v2, shorten the grace period from 90 to 28 days, and transfer all v2 contract admin control to the DAO, with existing .eth holders needing no action; the proposal remains in draft stage.
